<div class="card-body">
'''Stormtrooper Backpack''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ストームトルーパー・バックパック</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意の兵員／トルーパーに配備する。その兵員には武器やアイテムをいくつでも配備できる。惑星の位置カードにいるなら、その兵員は耐：損耗＜３を持つ。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">帝国軍の標準支給品で、サバイバル用品と野営用装備がおさまっている。遠征用に、弾薬や食料も貯蔵可能。これさえあれば、単独でも自給できる。</span>''

<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Stormtrooper Backpack.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on any soldier/trooper. Any number of weapons and devices may be deployed on that soldier. While at a planet site, that soldier is immune to attrition less than 3.

'''Lore:''' Standard Imperial equipment containing survival supplies and camping gear. Ammunition and food for an expedition can also be stored. With this alone, one can be self-sufficient.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says any number of weapons and devices may be deployed on the soldier; the English printed face says the trooper may carry and use any number of weapons and devices. Both give immunity to attrition less than 3 at a planet site. The Japanese calls the eligible character soldier/trooper.<ref name="comparison">[https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/170557233/iY7HG7XS4kmuRbKX2yvIdg.jpg Japanese printed face], PSA; [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a9/Premiere-D-stormtrooperbackpack-decipher-archive.gif English printed face].</ref>
